notes: v154: (1) Amazon's purchase limit is recognised. When Amazon answers 'you've reached the purchase limit for this item' Restalker says so (one phone message), stops sending checkouts for that product for 6 hours instead of every minute, and keeps it set to Buy - nothing is locked; choosing Buy again ends the rest at once. (2) A turning circle with words shows while Restalker is working on something you asked for, e.g. preparing the diagnostics. (3) The yellow '--no-sandbox' line: it was Chrome's own note in the 'Hidden Chrome' buying browser only; that browser is now started with Chrome's sandbox on.
